items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 18 at 1:23AM EST until November 20 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 knots with gusts up to 35 knots and
seas 9 to 14 feet.

* WHERE...Portions of Atlantic coastal waters.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
